test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends, P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in two rows, three in each. S is not at the end of any row. T is a neighbour of R. R and U are sitting diagonally opposite to each other. P is second to the left of U. Who among the following three friends are in the same row?
solution:

Hence, the correct answer is **"PSU and RTQ".**
